releases.overview: Welcome to version 1.7.0. This release introduces in-app release companion videos, coordination doc QR codes for guests, mobile BFA tagging parity, and enhanced security protections.

items.text: What's New Video companion: watch key release updates in the announcement on web or follow the link on mobile
Coordination document guest QR codes: instant QR code generation for quick guest joining on web and mobile
BFA intake tag parity with web
Multi-factor authentication (TOTP) support across web and mobile
In-app feedback follow-up thread editing and deletion
Firebase App Check integration for web
Enforced noindex headers and redacted record identifiers from published feedback URLs
Restricted access screen for non-allowlisted accounts
Auto-draft release notes workflow on release tags
Enhanced grid responsiveness to prevent clipping on compact displays
Your notes read-back view

releases.title: Founders, Partnerships & Attendance
lines: A contact's founders are now co-equal, and the caregiver role is retired — caring ties read who has taken a person on.
Attendance moves onto the Gathering, so one page holds the roll and the meeting.
Bible study copies a permanent per-week link, and coordination docs can be shared with guests.
Tagging now suggests BFA and clears the new-contact tag after five days.
releases.overview: Welcome to the latest release. This update reworks how partners and caring relationships are modelled, moves attendance onto the Gathering, and adds easier sharing.

items.text: Partners: founders are co-equal, and the current-term widening is retired
Founders are recorded when a person is brought in by a pair, and existing contacts are backfilled
Attendance moves onto the Gathering, with a staged intake and review
Coordination docs can be shared with guests via a link
Bible study copies a permanent per-week link, not just the latest
Bible study renders the verse reference in accent color
Tags suggest BFA and auto-remove the new-contact tag after five days
Retain directory filters when returning from a contact detail
Around-the-team surfaces public sign-up contacts to Full-timers, and keeps one worked-through conversation state
A self-dismissed bottom sheet no longer re-dismisses
Contact caregiver field and care transfer are removed
Taking someone into your sheep never grants reach; a carer tie ends with the tie that granted it
The empty "This week" prayer eyebrow aligns with the spine dot
Fixed an endless reload loop when a lazy chunk fails

releases.title: Contacts, Queue & Sharing
lines: A contact's co-owners can now manage its collaborators, and an impersonation hole is closed.
Your Around-the-team filters are kept when a comment posts, and you get a clear confirmation.
Full-timers' message cards in the queue are scoped to their own people, and a crash when reading a trainee's messages is fixed.
releases.overview: Welcome to the latest release. This update makes contact collaboration safer and clearer, keeps your feed filters in place, and fixes a few crashes in the message queue.

items.text: Co-owners can manage a contact's collaborators, and an impersonation bypass is closed
Around-the-team now keeps your filters and confirms when a comment posts
Message cards in the queue are scoped to a full-timer's own people
Fixed a crash when a trainee's impersonated messages were read

releases.title: September Platform & Mobile Updates
lines: The web app now has a command palette: jump to anyone or anything, and search the whole app from the keyboard.
Bible study gets an interactive reader and editor, so a passage can be opened on a phone and edited together.
Your news feed can now be filtered by team and teammate, so you can read just the people you carry.
Administrative Settings has a two-phase test-account purge, and contact ownership now transfers cleanly when the owner is unassigned.
releases.overview: Welcome to the latest version of CISA Campus Work Tracker! This update introduces custom release announcements, enhanced contact ownership tools, and expanded mobile navigation.

items.text: Fast keyboard shortcuts and global search with ⌘K palette
Interactive QR Bible study reader and editor
Filter News Feed by team and teammate
Two-phase Test Account Purge tool in Administrative Settings
Touch targets and action layout optimizations across all screens
Simplified prayer fold and history tracking
Contact owner transfer when owner is unassigned and you are the creator
